lines.t: (Verse 1)
Neon cross on an empty street, flickers out while the sirens sing
Billboards preaching a plastic peace, while the faithful trade You for a screen
I see halos turned to headphones, holy words drowned in the noise
My brothers laughing at the chains they wear, calling iron “freedom” in their void(Pre-Chorus)
And I’m walking through their fever dream
With my eyes awake and my hands still clean
Yeah, the city’s drunk on its own truth
But I remember You(Chorus)
So RIP to this world’s illusion,
RIP to the lies I knew
Let it burn in the glare of Your fire,
I was dead, now I live in You
While the skyline shakes and the idols fall,
I’ll be feasting at Your table still
In the ruin of a faithless world,
You’re the only One that’s real(Verse 2)
Empty churches full of smoke and lights, talking grace with unbent knees
Golden calves with electric eyes, selling hope in HD
I see sermons signed by corporations, prophets paid to keep them blind
While the narrow road grows overgrown, they pave the highway to the fire(Bridge)
They say, “Wake up, man, you’re losing out,”
But they’re sleepwalking to the edge
I see the storm in the face of the crowd,
All dancing on a breaking ledge
Still You pull me from their current,
Seat me where the wine runs true
My soul is the loudest siren,
Crying, “World, He has chosen you!”(Chorus)
So RIP to this world’s illusion,
RIP to the lies I knew
Let it burn in the glare of Your fire,
I was dead, now I live in You
While the skyline shakes and the idols fall,
I’ll be feasting at Your table still
In the ruin of a faithless world,
You’re the only One that’s real(Outro)
Yeah, the night screams that we’re all alone,
But I’m carried by a different sound
In the echo of a dying age,
I’m the trumpet that You’ve found
